solidworks_simulation_apply_link_connect.doc: Add a link connector between two vertices of a simulation study and return a read-back report. Writes a load into the study and judges success by the load and restraint counts rising by exactly one; pass vertices, because faces or components silently build nothing here.

params.study_name: Name of an existing simulation study; leaving it empty uses the first study in the document. Defaults to empty.
params.first: Declarative selector for the first vertex: 'index:<n>' for the n-th vertex on the body, or '__current_selection__' to take the first current selection; bare coordinates are rejected and an unparseable selector raises.
params.second: Declarative selector for the second vertex, using the same 'index:<n>' or '__current_selection__' forms as first.
params.first_body_index: Zero-based index of the body that the first selector indexes into. Defaults to 0.
params.second_body_index: Zero-based index of the body for the second selector; both vertices may live on the same body. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_macro_record_lines.doc: Write a few lines into a macro by turning recording on, writing each line and turning it off again. Writes recording state and returns the individual booleans; whether the macro file was really written cannot be proven, because the closing command opens a Save As dialog and is never used.

params.lines: Code lines to write, either a list or one newline-separated string, where blank lines are dropped. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_hole_wizard_at_point.doc: Create a Hole Wizard hole at an explicit point and read the hole parameters back. Writes a hole feature and does not save the document; the ray starts above the given point and goes down, and the feature tree growing is the success criterion rather than the return value.

params.z_mm: Z of the face the hole is drilled into, in millimetres; the ray is lifted from here and fired back down.
params.size: Fastener size string such as 'M8'; an empty string or a bare number makes the wizard return nothing.
params.diameter_mm: Hole diameter in millimetres. Defaults to 8.
params.depth_mm: Hole depth in millimetres when the hole is not through all geometry. Defaults to 20.
params.through: Whether the hole goes through all geometry, in which case the depth is ignored. Defaults to true.
